title: Abdomen locator · stomach label r01
finding: The revised leader takes a clearer route to the stomach and the label aligns with its neighbors. Only its path and label height changed.
limit: The previous endpoint already fell inside the stomach and outside the spleen. The review covers the English locator and visual ambiguity. The original organ shapes, materials, positions and metadata were preserved.
credit: Original whole-body atlas artwork and credits are retained in the SVG.

title: Bronchial tree · lobar junction r09
status: Local improvement · whole asset needs revision
finding: Compared with r07, r09 removes the visible near-side dimple at the displayed resolution, reduces the narrow collar and softens the opposite-side ridge. The r08 trial was rejected because its small displacements gave too little visible improvement.
limit: Exact GLB reimport and matched Blender stills support the local finding. Measured maximum displacement was 0.420132 mm. Angular routing, thin schematic branches, closed ends, other irregularities and an unrelated foreground crossing remain. The sampled areas cover whole-mesh sections. Airway caliber and flow are outside the review scope.
credit: Associated source: Jakob Wasserthal, TotalSegmentator contributors and University Hospital Basel, CC BY 4.0. The authored airway geometry has its own recorded scope.

limit: The 17 representative bilateral levels leave the complete 31-pair map, rootlets, ganglia, meninges, vessels and vertebrae outside scope. Dimensions and routes are authored. The remaining angular joins and cut ends are visible in the exact export.
